Title: Public Preview: MySQL 8.4 LTS for Azure Database for MySQL

Body.Content:
We're pleased to announce the release of MySQL 8.4 LTS for Azure Database for MySQL, a stable, long-term support version. MySQL 8.4 LTS is the ideal choice when you need a dependable, consistent database solution that evolves with your needs. You can confidently build and scale your applications using Azure Database for MySQL, knowing you have the latest in performance optimizations, security enhancements, and Azure integration features—fully supported over the long term. This release gives you the benefit of ongoing updates, minimizing disruptions and helping you maintain a resilient infrastructure for your mission-critical workloads. 

 

Learn more.
